question: Which of the following dances is performed by the Korku tribe?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chatkora**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chatkora** is a traditional dance form performed by the **Korku tribe**.
 
• The Korku tribe is primarily found in the Indian states of **Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra**.
 
• Chatkora dance is often performed during **festivals and community gatherings**, reflecting the cultural heritage of the tribe.
 
• This dance form is characterized by its **vibrant movements and rhythmic patterns**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Korku Tribe**

 
 
• The Korku tribe is an indigenous tribal community in India, recognized as one of the Scheduled Tribes.
 
• They primarily inhabit the regions of the Satpura range in Madhya Pradesh and parts of Maharashtra.
 
• Their traditional occupation includes farming, hunting, and gathering forest products.
 
• The Korkus have their own distinct language called "Korku," which belongs to the Munda language family.
 
 
 
• **Traditional Dances of Tribes in India**
 
 
• Tribal dances in India are an integral part of their culture and are performed during festivals, rituals, and social gatherings.
 
• These dances often convey stories, celebrate nature, and express communal harmony.
 
• Examples include the Santal dance by the Santal tribe and the War dance by the Nagas.
 
 
 
• **Preservation of Tribal Culture**
 
 
• The Indian government and various non-governmental organizations are actively working towards preserving the rich cultural heritage of tribal communities.
 
• Efforts include documentation, promoting traditional art forms, and providing platforms for showcasing their culture.
 
• Tribal museums and cultural festivals are organized to exhibit their traditions and crafts.
